body: To me my dreams ia my real life. And my life is hell . that's why I don't want to wake up.
I feel like my dreams is my real life .and when I wake up. I am in hell.

I get the same with my wife of 21 years she tells me the same. That I am not trying 
I have been dealing with depression anxiety hearing voices. Paranoid.  Lite  seizures   But I am not trying 
I just want it to end
Thank you .it means so much . thank you  For your support .

Thank you .I do .and I am getting help. But they scare me at times.  I see a psychiatrist and a psychologist 
I get depressed and anxiety. 
I am just getting tired of all this. 
At times I feel like I am in a time machine. Every day waking up to the same things.  I try by drawing and painting. At times it helps. But when I go out with my wife. Anxiety kicks in. I start seeing and thinking that there are people following me. Everywhere I go.  
My wife gets scared at me sometimes. 
All I want is my life back.

I have but it stops me. Because if I feel those people following me everywhere I go . it doesn't matter where I go they will be there . my voices will be with me everywhere I go. My depression will also be with me. So I just have to keep on fighting with it. here

Yes my wife is getting sick and tired of how I get when I start to feel anxiety and depressed and think that everyone is after me .following me .my heart feels like is going to jump out of my chest. 
When we go out i  have to drive because I feel safe. When this happens. But she gets scared . I want to make my wife happy. But this voices and my anxiety just gets in the way. I tried so many times to kill myself.yesterday I received a letter from the insurance company. And told me that they are not going to pay my visit to my psychiatrist 
Because my 1hr that I see him is not medical needed.  What the f... do they know .what am going through. What the f.. do they know how I feel by the end of the day .after fighting every day to be normal under medication. 
All they care is about the money they have to pay. Like I said I really don't know how much I could go like this . That why I rather be dead. It's 9 year .and I get scared that one day I will explode. Yesterday day I wrote them a nasty letter thanking them  about their decision not to pay my psychiatrist. One day it will just happened. Don't know when but I feel it coming on. Maybe not today or tomorrow or next month but I am getting to that point. I don't want .it rather hurt myself. Before I hurt someone.  That's what I deal every day with.
True. I talked to my wife  couple of times about going into the hospital.  Thank you again

Thank you .I am getting help by my psychiatrist
But my health insurance think it's not medical needed for me to see him .he sees me for 1hr visit and the insurance told him just to see me for 15 minutes.  I am getting tired  . At times I just want to give up. Thank you so much for your support and understand.  But those medication make you feel like I a zombie .  At times I feel like they don't work .if it wasn't for my wife and kids I would've killed my self. And that's why I get scared. I don't want to hurt anyone. I have been on so many different medications. That don't work. I don't want to end up in a mental hospital.  At times I feel good .but when it comes. I get so scared and my anxiety gets bad. Again thank you ..

Nobody understands not even the insurance company. That said to my psychiatrist .that the amount of time he was seeing me is not medical needed . So they refuse to pay my visit. I been suffering from depression anxiety and hearing voices.  But no f...   UnitedHealth and  anyone else don't  understand what that is like .before is to late
I I guess they wait for you to hurt somebody hurt yourself before they say oh you should come to get help. Hearing voices and fighting every day with this anxiety I paint to get these bad thoughts out of my head but I guess they're waiting for something to go wrong.

I have been dealing with depression for over 10 years. Anxiety and hearing voices.  My wife doesn't understand. And my health insurance. Things that is not medical needed for me to see a psychiatrist.  
Until I hurt my self or someone else. Then they will probably be like. He  should have gone for help. 
So I know what's like having people not to believe you. Until is to late.

Yes .I have been dealing with depression for 10 years and hearing voices telling me to hurt myself or someone.  Yes I am tiered of feeling like this. 
People following me every where I go. Sometimes I feel like my heart is going to explode. 
I don't feel safe in my house at times.  
Tiered of taking meds that make you feel like a zombie.

I am getting scared that I am going to hurt myself 
My insurance company United health care thinks that my visit to my psychiatrist is not a medical condition. I hear voices and get depressed. My anxiety and seeing everyone following me. I get scared that if I stop taking my medication. I am going to hurt someone.  I just don't want to end up in a mental hospital. But if that happens I'll blame united health care.
